how_to_apply: Applications go through the applicant's own employer, not directly. The application must reach by post through the proper channel on or before 01.12.2026 (05:00 PM).
Download the Vacancy Notification/Advertisement from nta.ac.in and check that you meet the eligibility criteria of the post.
Fill in the application form given as Annexure V and attach the documents listed below.
Submit the duly filled application to your Cadre Controlling Authority/Parent Organization, which forwards it to NTA with its certificates and documents.
The envelope must be clearly labelled "Application for the post of ______" (with the post name).
The application is sent to: The Director (Administration), National Testing Agency, 5th Floor, Government of India Press Building, Minto Road, New Delhi – 110002.
Send a copy of the application by email to [email protected].
Attached by the applicant with the application form (Annexure V):
Self-attested copy of the certificate/document in respect of claimed educational qualification.
Experience Certificate in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-II), as applicable, on the letterhead of the organisation.
Certificate given by Head of Department including Vigilance/Administrative clearance (Annexure-III).
No Objection Certificate by Head of Department (Annexure-IV).
A passport size photo affixed on the application form.
Forwarded by the Cadre Controlling Authority/Parent Organization:
Copy of the application form (Annexure V) duly filled by the applicant, with the certificates of the Cadre Controlling Authority/Parent Organization.

Attested photocopy of the complete and up-to-date APAR Dossier for the last 05 years (up to 2025-26); a No Report Certificate (NRC) where an APAR was not written for a year or a part (less than 03 months) of a year.
Vigilance Clearance Certificate.
Integrity Certificate.
A Statement of Major/Minor Penalty (if any) during the last 10 years.
Cadre Clearance/No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Cadre Controlling/Parent organization.
important_instructions: Applications not received through proper channel will not be considered. Applications received without proper channel and/or without the requisite documents will be summarily rejected. Applications not meeting the eligibility criteria or found incomplete/deficient will be summarily rejected. Applications received after the last date shall not be entertained. Candidates must not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars or suppress any material information. The decision of NTA in all matters of eligibility, scrutiny stages, documents for the interview and selection shall be final. NTA reserves the right to amend/change/delete/cancel any condition at any stage, and to cancel the recruitment process for any post without prior notice or reason. Enquiries: Telephone 011 40759000; e-mail [email protected] (printed on the letterhead).

content_sections.heading: About NTA
content_sections.text: The National Testing Agency describes itself on its letterhead as "An Autonomous Organization under the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India", with the tagline "Excellence in Assessment". Its office is at the Fifth Floor, Government of India Press Building, Minto Road, New Delhi – 110002. The notice is signed by Akash Jain, Director (Adm/Estt).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 13 vacancies across five posts. NTA states that the vacancies shown are indicative and may increase or decrease.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All five posts are filled on deputation, so only officers already in regular service can apply. The officers having regular service in a substantive post in the pay levels required by the eligibility conditions of the recruitment rules are eligible. Officers getting the desired level of pay under ACP/MACP/Adhoc are not eligible. Educational qualifications, experience and other criteria must be met as on the closing date of application. The maximum age limit for all posts is 56 years as on the closing date of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Experience (any one): Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre/department in relevant area; OR 03 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in pay Level 12: ₹78800-209200 or equivalent in the parent cadre/department in relevant area; OR 05 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in Level 11: ₹67700-208700 or equivalent in the parent cadre/department in relevant area. Desirable: (1) Master's/Directorate degree in the relevant field; (2) Experience of working in large scale assessments/assessment organizations. Experience (any one): Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre/department in relevant area; OR 03 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in pay Level 11: ₹67700-208700 or equivalent in the parent cadre/department in relevant area; OR 05 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in Level 10: ₹56100-177500 or equivalent in the parent cadre/department in relevant area. Desirable: (1) Master's degree in the relevant field; (2) Experience of working in an Examination System of a University/Board. Experience: Post Qualification experience of 10 years in assessment sectors/relevant area; AND any one of the following: Holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre/department; OR 03 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in pay Level 11: ₹67700-208700 or equivalent in the parent cadre/department; OR 05 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in Level 10: ₹56,100-1,77,500 or equivalent in the parent cadre/department. Desirable: (1) Experience of at least two years in the assessment sectors; (2) Persons having experience in Psychometric Testing shall be given preference. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each post carries the 7th CPC pay level shown in the vacancy table. The period of deputation/foreign service shall be initially for three years. The terms and conditions on deputation/Foreign Service shall be regulated as per the Instructions of DoP&T, vide OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17 June, 2010 as amended from time to time. The notice does not list allowances separately.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: NTA reserves the right to fix criteria for screening/shortlisting the applications so as to reduce the number of candidates called for interview. Merely fulfilling the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to an interview or selection. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview; they must submit documents in support of age, qualifications, service record/experience, etc. and get the originals verified at the time of interview. A candidate found ineligible during document verification shall not be allowed to take up the interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NTA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies: 7 Director, 3 Joint Director, 1 Research Scientist 'C', 1 Deputy Director and 1 Sr. Superintendent / Sr. Superintendent (Accounts); NTA calls these indicative and they may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for NTA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application must reach NTA by post through the proper channel on or before 01.12.2026 (05:00 PM).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NTA deputation posts?
faq.answer: Director, Joint Director and Deputy Director need a Bachelor's Degree in any field from a recognized University or equivalent; Sr. Superintendent needs a Bachelor's Degree plus knowledge of office procedures, rules, computer applications and secretarial practice; Research Scientist 'C' needs PhD with PG (minimum 55% marks) in a listed subject, along with the required service experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NTA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 56 years as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an NTA Director on deputation?
faq.answer: The Director post is in Pay Level 13 of the 7th CPC, Rs.123100 – 215900; other posts range from Pay Level 7 (Rs.44900 – 142400) to Pay Level 12 (Rs.78800 – 209200).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NTA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure V form, attach the required certificates and submit it through your Cadre Controlling Authority/Parent Organization to The Director (Administration), National Testing Agency, 5th Floor, Government of India Press Building, Minto Road, New Delhi – 110002, with a copy emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NTA deputation posts?
faq.answer: NTA may screen and shortlist the applications, and only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, where original documents are verified.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NTA job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on deputation basis/foreign service terms, and the period of deputation/foreign service is initially for three years.

faq.question: Q9. Can officers getting pay under MACP apply?
faq.answer: No, officers getting the desired level of pay under ACP/MACP/Adhoc are not eligible; regular service in a substantive post in the required pay level is needed.

faq.question: Q10. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must be clearly labelled "Application for the post of ______" with the post applied for.
